dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer contains five polygons representing the city's Neighborhood Conservation Districts (NCDs). Conservation districts are groups of buildings and their surroundings that are architecturally and historically distinctive. Exterior changes to buildings within NCDs are subject to review by NCD commissions made up of residents appointed by the City Manager.

Purpose: Any changes to the boundaries of the NCDs shown in this layer must be approved by the City Council. The district layer can be overlaid on parcel maps to indicate which properties must undergo review.
